title: sprite.ts: symbol-internal SHAPE drops blendMode when filters present (first-placement branch order)
description:
ORACLE-CONFIRMED BUG filed by task 1372. The DefineSprite shape FIRST-PLACEMENT branch in packages/swf/src/sprite.ts (~line 752) tests hasEnabledFilters() BEFORE the blend branch and routes to encodePlaceObject3WithFilters (which writes HasFilterList+HasCacheAsBitmap but NO blend byte / no HasBlendMode). The blend branch (~line 761) is the unreachable else-if. So a symbol-internal ShapeDisplayObject carrying BOTH a non-normal blendMode AND enabled filters silently DROPS the blend. This is the EXACT task-1240 defect that was fixed for the SCENE path (compiler/frames.ts) but never for the sprite path. It is distinct from task 1110 (which covered sprite.ts TEXT/BITMAP, not shapes).

RUNTIME-OBSERVABLE in real bundled Ruffle (not byte-only): a red shape (255,0,0) + multiply blend + glow over a cyan (0,255,255) backdrop renders BLACK via the scene path (correct, blend applied) but plain RED via the sprite path (blend dropped). Confirmed during task 1372's e2e run.

FIX (mirror the already-correct sprite shape MOVE branch ~line 995, which checks hasShapeBlend first and passes the filter list; and the scene path frames.ts): reorder the sprite first-placement shape branch so a non-normal blendMode routes to encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode(charId, depth, x, y, blendMode, filters, objTransform, ...) carrying BOTH the filter list and the blend byte (SWF field order: FILTERLIST then BlendMode then is_bitmap_cached). Filters-only and blend-only fall through unchanged.

ACCEPTANCE: remove test.fixme on apps/desktop/e2e/multiflag-placeobject-1372.spec.ts test '(c)' (it becomes green) AND invert test '(c-bug)' in the same file to assert the sprite PO3 now HAS HasBlendMode and the multiply interior renders dark (matching the scene path). Add a sprite-blendmode unit gate mirroring blendmode.test.ts tests 7-9. Do NOT regress the scene-path 1240 gate. See docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md OPEN BUG note.
